title: Shadow of a Doubt trailer
subtitle: A surreal 3D animated short exploring the unreality of contemporary existence—born from the feeling that reality has become somewhat "make-believe."  Inspired by Baudrillard’s theory of Simulacra, the film traces an intimate search for comfort within a web of symbols that maintain a visual dialogue with their own unreality, fracturing upon encounter. Critiquing the reproduction of images, the project reveals how the pursuit of genuine emotion is replaced by digital simulations, and the promise of authenticity dissolves into an illusion that dilutes and distorts reality.

title: Pirates
subtitle:
An explainer video exploring "The Pirates"—a wonderfully strange and unique phenomenon: a group uniting around a shared love for wandering, urban anarchy, and surrender to local absurdity.
A total solo endeavor where I handled everything from the ground up—scriptwriting, filming, animating, editing, and sound design.

Massive thanks to everyone who supported this project, and to The Pirates for keeping Jerusalem beautiful for over a decade. Come push the cart this Purim!

title: From A to B
subtitle:
A car moving from point A to point B follows a clean, mechanical path. We often apply this same logic to our lives, hoping to move through obstacles without friction, seeking a "correct" way forward.
Inspired by Primo Levi’s If This Is a Man, this animation explores the idea that life’s "troubles" aren't just interruptions to be avoided. It is exactly this friction—the complications we try to bypass—that actually keeps us present.
